name: Release gate
description: Checklists that must be all ticked before something ships, shared by you and your agents. An agent ticks a check with mod_write when it has proved it, and says how in the check's note.

gates.description: A checklist, such as one release. Archived gates stay for the record and leave the picker.

checks.description: One check of a gate, named by the gate's id. note says how it was proved, such as a CI run or commit.
